```python
import pandas as pd
file_path = '/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/32102e3e-d12a-4209-9163-7b3a104efe5d.xlsx'

df = pd.read_excel(file_path, skiprows=2)
format_rows = {'DVD', 'Blu-Ray'}
df['Format'] = None
current = None
for i, t in enumerate(df['Title'].astype(str).str.strip()):
    if t in format_rows:
        current = t
        df.at[i, 'Format'] = current
    else:
        df.at[i, 'Format'] = current

br = df[(df['Format'] == 'Blu-Ray') & (~df['Title'].isin(format_rows))].copy()
br['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(br['Year'], errors='coerce')
br = br.dropna(subset=['Year'])
oldest_year = br['Year'].min()
old_titles = br.loc[br['Year'] == oldest_year, 'Title']
print('Oldest year:', int(oldest_year))
print('Titles with oldest year:')
for t in old_titles:
    print('-', t)
```
